target.title: fix(doctor): flag missing plugin install paths
target.body:
## Summary
- Detect plugin install records whose persisted `installPath` / `sourcePath` no longer exists.
- Surface those as structured `openclaw doctor` findings and dry-run repair effects.
- Teach `openclaw doctor --fix` to remove missing-path install records before rebuilding the persisted plugin registry.

## What Problem This Solves
Stale persisted plugin install records can leave OpenClaw split-brained: config still enables an official plugin, but the installed-plugin index points at a removed `~/.openclaw/npm/projects/...` path. That makes model/plugin routes fail later at runtime instead of being caught by control-plane health checks.

This directly covers the failure mode where Codex/ZAI/DeepSeek were enabled in config but their persisted install records referenced missing plugin directories.

## Evidence
- Added regression coverage for detecting a missing Codex-style install path in `src/commands/doctor-plugin-registry.test.ts`.
- Added repair coverage proving `doctor --fix` removes the missing install record and rebuilds the registry.
- Local focused test: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/commands/doctor-plugin-registry.test.ts` → 16 passed.
- Local build: `pnpm build` → passed.
- Local guard: `pnpm check` reached existing `npm-shrinkwrap.json is stale` failure; all other check steps reported OK.

## Verification
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/commands/doctor-plugin-registry.test.ts` → 16 passed
- `pnpm build` → passed
- `pnpm check` → existing shrinkwrap guard failure: `npm-shrinkwrap.json is stale. Run pnpm deps:shrinkwrap:generate`; all other check steps passed.


## Scratch Doctor CLI Proof

Fixture: scratch OpenClaw state/config/home only, with `openclaw.json` set to `{}` and the persisted installed-plugin index seeded with `installRecords.missing-demo.installPath=<SCRATCH>/state/npm/projects/openclaw-missing-demo-old/node_modules/@example/missing-demo`. That path was intentionally absent.

```text
--- openclaw doctor --lint --only core/doctor/plugin-registry (exit 1) ---
{"ok":false,"checksRun":1,"checksSkipped":36,"findings":[{"checkId":"core/doctor/plugin-registry","severity":"warning","message":"Install record for plugin missing-demo points at a missing installPath.","path":"<SCRATCH>/state/npm/projects/openclaw-missing-demo-old/node_modules/@example/missing-demo","target":"missing-demo","fixHint":"Run `openclaw doctor --fix` to remove missing install records and rebuild the plugin registry."}]}

--- openclaw doctor --fix --non-interactive (relevant excerpt) ---
Removed plugin install record(s) with missing paths:
- missing-demo: installPath
  <SCRATCH>/state/npm/projects/openclaw-missing-demo-old/node_modules/@example/missing-demo
Plugin registry refreshed: 75/135 enabled plugins indexed.
Doctor complete.

--- openclaw doctor --lint --only core/doctor/plugin-registry after ---
{"ok":true,"checksRun":1,"checksSkipped":36,"findings":[]}

--- persisted installed plugin index after ---
{
  "installRecords": {},
  "refreshReason": "migration"
}
```
